title: SwaggerBuildInfo
description: Metadata about the embedded swagger.json — exposed by GET /api/docs/swagger.json's response headers for monitoring + drift detection.

spec_version.description: Value of info.version in the served swagger.json (sourced from git describe at build time)

generator.description: swaggo/swag CLI version that produced the spec

generated_at.description: Unix epoch seconds when swag init ran

endpoint_count.description: Number of paths declared in the spec
